title: 6.3.10 Car on a Ramp
description: Build a two-wheeled car using WheelJoints and drive it up a ramp with WASD. The harder of the two A14 options.

steps.title: Ground + ramp
steps.instructions: Two static sprites: a flat ground and a tilted ramp. Set the ramp's .rotation in degrees to tilt it (moSHion rotation is in degrees, not radians).
hints: The Sprite docs chapter (right drawer → Docs tab) covers static colliders.
ramp.rotation = -20 tilts up to the right; positive values tilt the other way.

steps.title: Chassis + wheels
steps.instructions: Chassis: one dynamic rectangle. Two wheels: dynamic sprites with a `diameter` so they're circular.
hints: Place the wheels slightly below the chassis corners so the joints have room.
The Physics docs chapter explains dynamic vs static bodies.

steps.title: Join the wheels with WheelJoint
steps.instructions: new WheelJoint(chassis, leftWheel) and again for the right wheel. A WheelJoint is a joint made for vehicles: it pins a wheel to the chassis so the wheel can spin freely.
hints: The Joints docs chapter covers WheelJoint, including suspension travel options.

steps.title: Drive with WASD
steps.instructions: In draw(), use kb.pressing('a') / kb.pressing('d') to set chassis.vel.x (positive = right, negative = left, 0 = stop). The grader looks for an assignment to .vel.x (or an applyForce call).
hints: Open the Input docs chapter for kb.pressing. Don't use arrow keys: they scroll the editor.
vel.x sets horizontal velocity directly each frame; the wheels will roll from friction as the chassis moves. Spinning the wheels alone does not move the car.

requirements.title: Uses WheelJoint
requirements.description: Create at least one WheelJoint. Help: 6.3.8 (Worked Example: Swinging Pendulum)

requirements.title: Static geometry exists
requirements.description: Create at least one 'static' sprite (ground or ramp). Help: 5.2.6 (Bounciness and Friction)

requirements.title: Tilted ramp via rotation
requirements.description: Assign to .rotation: tilting the ramp. Help: 5.1.10 (Sprite property tour: pos, rotation, scale)

requirements.title: Gravity enabled
requirements.description: Assign a positive value to world.gravity.y. Help: 5.2.2 (Gravity)

requirements.title: WASD drives the car
requirements.description: Use kb.pressing with 'a' or 'd' inside draw(). Help: 5.1.14 (Keyboard Movement)

requirements.title: Drives the car
requirements.description: Assign to the chassis's .vel.x (or call applyForce on it) to move the car. Help: 5.1.15 (Velocity: vel.x and vel.y)
